title: Jaren contract port frame 0.1
description: The frame grammar of the port binding (packages/contract/docs/CONTRACT-FORMAT.md §16): every message the binding puts on a MessagePort, Worker or BroadcastChannel is one of these three JSON-safe plain objects, marked jaren: "contract/0.1" so contract traffic is distinguishable by shape from anything else sharing the channel. A request id is "<clientId>:<seq>" — the client id unique per client instance — so two clients on one channel can never cross-settle; the request members attempt and key are reserved and ignored by servers of this version.

id.description: A request id: the client id (no colon), a colon, the per-client sequence number.

request.description: A client's request: one operation invocation. input is the whole input object, or null for an input-less operation.

op.description: The operation id, as declared in the contract.

key.description: Reserved: an idempotency key. The port binding does not carry idempotency (capabilities say so); a server of this version ignores it.

response.description: A server's answer to one request id, success or error, always carrying the server trace.

trace.description: The server's per-request trace id (meta.trace on the client).

error.description: The error envelope of a failed response: a declared error code (lowercase) or a JC2xxx taxonomy/binding code; details present only when the failure carries some.

cancel.description: A client's cancellation of one request id: aborts the server-side signal. An optimization — the id scoping is the guarantee — and never answered.
